name: FOMC Intermeeting Drift
tagline: Owns TQQQ only in the middle of the FOMC intermeeting cycle and holds BIL through the post-decision unwind and late pre-meeting de-risking.
summary: For each of the 63 scheduled FOMC decisions from 2016 to 2023, buys TQQQ at the open of session F+3 and holds through the close of F+20 (18 sessions), with BIL otherwise. Dev 2016-2023 earns 51.06% CAGR / 48.83% max drawdown / 1.17 Sharpe at 1 bp, but the edge is concentrated in 2020 and 2022 and the ex-2020 CAGR falls to 33.4%, below the TQQQ bar.
caveat: The holdout is not a real test: the FOMC calendar is hardcoded only through 2023, so 2024-2026 sits in BIL at roughly 5-6% a year, and even the dev pass depends on 2020 (ex-2020 CAGR 33.4%, below the bar).
